summary.headline: The Seven Days and Seven Stars
summary.text: Defense of astrology against ecclesiastical critics, introducing a scripturally supported correspondence between the seven days of creation and the seven stars. The first day is assigned to the Sun and Moses, with Genesis used to explain the Sun’s illumination and the creation of heaven and earth.
